pilot_before: Start R to run gsm’s workflows on the loaded study’s adsl.csv and adae.csv. It downloads about 55 MB, once: R itself from webr.r-wasm.org (about 13 MB), its packages from repo.r-wasm.org (about 40 MB) and gsm’s packages from this page (about 2 MB). The files stay in this browser, and R runs here.
pilot_summary: The loaded study supports 3 of 8 metrics. R makes gsm’s raw tables from its adsl.csv and adae.csv.
pilot_gives: adsl.csv, the Subject-level file, gives Raw_SITE, Raw_STUDCOMP, Raw_STUDY and Raw_SUBJ.
adae.csv, the Adverse events file, gives Raw_AE.
pilot_support: AE Adverse Event Rate: the files and columns it needs are loaded.
SAE Serious Adverse Event Rate: the files and columns it needs are loaded.
PD Non-Important Protocol Deviation Rate needs Raw_PD.csv, which is not loaded.
IPD Important Protocol Deviation Rate needs Raw_PD.csv, which is not loaded.
LB Grade 3+ Lab Abnormality Rate needs Raw_LB.csv, which is not loaded.
SDSC Study Discontinuation Rate: the files and columns it needs are loaded.
TDSC Treatment Discontinuation Rate needs Raw_SDRGCOMP.csv, which is not loaded.
SF Screen Failure Rate needs Raw_ENROLL.csv, which is not loaded.
pilot_starting: Starting R: installing its packages, about 40 MB from repo.r-wasm.org and about 2 MB from this page. This is the longest step.
pilot_done: R ran 3 of 8 metrics on the loaded study’s adsl.csv and adae.csv in 2.7 seconds, 115 seconds after Start R was pressed. The snapshot is dated 2026-10-08. R 4.6.0, gsm.core 1.3.1, gsm.mapping 1.1.6, gsm.reporting 1.1.7 and workr 1.1.0. The metric workflows are gsm.kri 1.7.0’s and the charts gsm.viz 2.4.1’s.
pilot_choices: Non-Important Protocol Deviation Rate needs Raw_PD.csv, which is not loaded.
Important Protocol Deviation Rate needs Raw_PD.csv, which is not loaded.
Grade 3+ Lab Abnormality Rate needs Raw_LB.csv, which is not loaded.
Treatment Discontinuation Rate needs Raw_SDRGCOMP.csv, which is not loaded.
Screen Failure Rate needs Raw_ENROLL.csv, which is not loaded.
pilot_why: Screen Failure Rate needs Raw_ENROLL.csv, which is not loaded.
unmapped_why: Adverse Event Rate needs the column SITEID, which no column of adsl.csv is mapped to.
study_before: Start R to run gsm’s workflows on the 9 loaded raw files. It downloads about 55 MB, once: R itself from webr.r-wasm.org (about 13 MB), its packages from repo.r-wasm.org (about 40 MB) and gsm’s packages from this page (about 2 MB). The files stay in this browser, and R runs here.
study_summary: 9 files loaded, 9 placed in a gsm raw domain. They support 8 of 8 metrics.
study_done: R ran 8 of 8 metrics on the 9 loaded files in 4.1 seconds, 106 seconds after Start R was pressed. The snapshot is dated 2026-10-08. R 4.6.0, gsm.core 1.3.1, gsm.mapping 1.1.6, gsm.reporting 1.1.7 and workr 1.1.0. The metric workflows are gsm.kri 1.7.0’s and the charts gsm.viz 2.4.1’s.
own_done: R ran 2 of 8 metrics on the 2 loaded files in 1 second. The snapshot is dated 2026-10-08. R 4.6.0, gsm.core 1.3.1, gsm.mapping 1.1.6, gsm.reporting 1.1.7 and workr 1.1.0. The metric workflows are gsm.kri 1.7.0’s and the charts gsm.viz 2.4.1’s.
own_summary: 3 files loaded, 2 placed in a gsm raw domain. They support 2 of 8 metrics.
own_files: Raw_SUBJ.csv is Raw_SUBJ, by its name.
Raw_AE.csv is Raw_AE, by its name.
site_notes.csv is not recognised: its name and its columns match no gsm raw domain.
